name: Opportunity Recognition
description: Identifying potential value in ambiguous or incomplete environments, often before it is obvious to others.

name: Problem Framing
description: Reinterpreting messy situations into actionable and solvable questions.

name: Resource Recombination
description: Using limited or unrelated resources in novel ways to create value.

name: Stakeholder Negotiation
description: Balancing competing needs, incentives, and power dynamics in collaborative environments.

name: Iterative Decision-Making
description: Making decisions under uncertainty and refining them based on feedback loops.

name: Value Proposition Design
description: Structuring offerings so that perceived value aligns with user needs and constraints.

name: Risk Interpretation
description: Understanding, communicating, and acting under uncertainty rather than eliminating it.
